author: Barrie Linch
text: I don't think this is bad at all. To those saying the spikes are too steep, I would point out that the whole thing is within range so the spikes can't be so terrible. Yes, the flatter the line, the better but, as long as you're in range and your overall average is not high, you're doing ok.
